title: We truly did not deserve Matilda on Broadway 😭😭😭 #broadway #matildath...
transcript: I'm going to the New York City tomorrow and I was looking through all my old playbills from over the decades of me seeing theater and I found my playbill for Matilda the musical when I saw it in 2015 and at this performance of Matilda The musical wept and I also caught one of the paper airplanes that the cast throws out during Revolting Children and it's really funny and I think we should talk about it so the front of it is a pretty regular uh report card for Alice Pumpernickel but the back of it where the trunchable makes remarks about this student is where it really gets good head teacher's remarks I have absolutely no idea who this child is in fact so nondescript is Alice that we do not even bother to put her name on a coat hook we have merely painted a strip of beige on the wall nearby are your other children as bland as this little pimple? I sincerely hope not the only hope for a child as dull as this is to put her in garish colours dayglows and the like perhaps give her extremely colourful socks? other than that well just forget about her everyone else has. -A Trunchbull you can pause and read the entire report card if you want Matilda the musical on Broadway was so special I'd yet to see something that blends pathos comedy and family entertainment that well I'm not supposed to sob at the kids show I'm not supposed to weep and put my head in my hands at the family Broadway musical yet I did at Matilda and the fact that Kinky Boots won best score and Best Musical over Matilda still makes little beads of rage sweat form on my bulbous never ending forehead because in this house Matilda supremacy only
